text:
Matt: Found a rubber pelican in the kitchen labeled 'Property of Unknown'. Can we make it an award for snack hero of the week? 🦜
Sana: 100% yes. Official office mascot + award. pelican of honor.
Kyle: :raised_hands: nominate @Olivia — she brought empanadas yesterday.
Olivia: those empanadas were questionable but empowering. I'll accept the pelican if ceremonial crumbs are allowed.
Meera: We should set rules. Rule 1: edible contributions only. Rule 2: no hoarding. Rule 3: pelican may not be used as a coaster.
Derek: I vote for @Matt because he rescued the pelican from the sink on his way to a meeting. Hero duties.
Jamie (Design): I can make a tiny sticker that says 'Snack Hero' to stick on the pelican's base. Want foil? 😂
Sana: Foil is non-negotiable. Also, can we have a 30s acceptance speech?
ops-bot: poll created: "Who should receive the inaugural Rubber Pelican?" — options: Olivia; Matt; Kyle; No Pelicans. React with :one: :two: :three: :four: to vote.
hr-bot: Friendly reminder: fun awards are great! Please follow the shared-food policy and label allergens.
Kyle: Proposal: quick ceremony Friday 3pm in the kitchen. Winner gets pelican + sticker + 1-week bragging rights.
Olivia: :trophy: sold. I'll bring celebratory chips and a tiny paper hat.
Meera: Also, we should record the winner on a little whiteboard so the pelican's lineage is clear.
Matt: Love it. The Pelican of the Pantry begins. Next step: engraving ideas? ("Pelican of Extraordinary Snacks")
Jamie (Design): I'll mock up a few sticker options and drop them here by EOD.
Sana: excited. can someone bring a tiny pedestal? maybe repurpose a coffee can + tape.
Derek: I have a spare Lego minifig base that could work as a starter pedestal.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: 'Rubber Pelican Ceremony' Friday 15:00 in #random.
Sana: This is peak Redwood culture. :heart:
Olivia: See you Friday — may the best snacker win!
